articleTitle: Research on Path Planning System for Vision-Based Control of Micro-Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This paper presents a path-planning system for micro-robots based on machine vision, designed to enable the efficient control of micro-robot swarms. Micro-robots have diverse applications in fields such as industry and education, including precision assembly, product inspection, teaching demonstrations, and scientific experiments, where they enhance operational accuracy and technical comprehension. To achieve synchronized swarm control, the proposed system employs a modular design approach, enabling each robot to operate as an independently controlled unit, while coordinated path design facilitates the collective movement of multiple robots. The hardware architecture integrates a positioning camera, a probe-based motion structure, and a power-drive circuit, while the software framework incorporates machine vision for positioning and pose recognition, a path navigation system, and Wi-Fi communication. This integrated approach equips the micro-robots with precise tracking and path-planning capabilities, ensuring the efficient execution of specified path trajectories.

articleTitle: Pooling-Priority Architecture for Efficient Deep Learning Acceleration on FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This study proposed an innovative hardware architecture to accelerate the implementation of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on mid-to-Iow-end field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA). The design reorders the computation sequence by performing pooling operations before applying ReLU and other activation functions, which effectively reduces the nonlinear processing data volume and thus reduces the computational load and hardware resource requirements, significantly improving the processing efficiency of deep learning tasks. Simulation results verify the correctness of the proposed system, and the hardware power consumption is significantly reduced, with a total power consumption of 0.5293 mW, of which 52% is attributed to switching power. Overall, the proposed hardware architecture provides an efficient solution for implementing CNNs in resource-constrained environments and provides a viable new approach for deploying deep learning models on low-power FPGA platforms, enabling wider application in edge computing and IoT devices.

articleTitle: Research on Edge Node Data Processing Technology in Multi-Tier Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Edge node data processing in supply chain networks faces challenges such as real-time performance, reliability, and resource optimization. This paper analyzes the data characteristics and processing requirements of edge nodes in multi-tier supply chains and proposes a three-tier edge computing architecture. It designs differentiated processing strategies tailored to various levels of nodes, achieving core functions such as data preprocessing, distributed computation, and real-time analysis. By utilizing an edge-cloud collaborative framework and a resource scheduling algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning, the overall system performance is significantly improved. Experimental results demonstrate that this solution outperforms traditional architectures in terms of processing capability, response time, and resource utilization, offering a feasible technological approach and practical reference for large-scale supply chain network edge data processing.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Seedling Planter Positioning and Navigation System Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: To meet the demand for automation in agricultural production, a precision seedling planting robot system based on RTK-GNSS/IMU combined navigation is designed. The system uses STM32H743 to design the controller hardware, achieving positioning, navigation, and planting collaborative control. The experimental results show that the system has a horizontal positioning accuracy of 1.8cm, navigation control straight-line segment error of 1.6cm, planting depth error of 1.2cm, and seedling spacing error of 1.8cm. At an operating speed of 0.8m/s, the single-block operating efficiency reaches 0.42 hectares/hour, and the seedling survival rate is 98.2%, achieving the expected design goals.

articleTitle: Network Shared Data Mining Technology and Application Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to further improve network shared data mining effect, this paper proposes a network shared data mining technology based on deep learning, which adopts a multi-layer graph convolution network structure, and gradually expands the receptive field by stacking multiple graph convolution layers, thus capturing a wider range of neighborhood information. The adopted GCN model is based on the information aggregation mechanism of local neighborhood, and the characterization of nodes is updated layer by layer by using the feature information and topological structure of nodes. In addition to this, the adopted codec network structure includes an encoder, which is responsible for learning the compressed representations of the input data, and a decoder, which reconstructs the input data from these representations. Combined with the experimental research, it can be seen that the accuracy of the method proposed in this paper is over 90% for multi-source heterogeneous data aggregation. Moreover, compared with the existing algorithms, the data aggregation speed of this method is faster and has better data aggregation effect.

articleTitle: Distributed Artificial Intelligence Algorithm Design in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This article discusses creating distributed AI algorithms for edge computing and suggests a model optimization framework using federated learning to boost computing efficiency and real-time system performance. In common smart grid use cases, edge nodes can effectively handle large amounts of real-time data by utilizing distributed architecture, decreasing communication delays with local model updates, and improving the system's performance as a whole. This paper compares the performance differences between distributed and centralized models in experiments. The results show that the distributed model performs well in terms of convergence speed, communication delay and system response time, and has stronger scalability and adaptability. This algorithm can not only effectively reduce network load, but also ensure data privacy and security, providing theoretical support and application examples for the design of distributed artificial intelligence algorithms in edge computing environments.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Model for Real-time Data Processing of Brain-Computer Interface System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the field of brain-computer interface (BCI), by accurately capturing and analyzing brain neural signals, building a bridge of direct communication between people and digital devices, it has shown great application potential and prospects. Despite this, efficient processing of real-time data is still regarded as one of the key problems that need to be solved in this field. In view of this, this paper innovatively proposes an efficient real-time data processing architecture based on deep learning technology, the core of which is an advanced model based on variational autoencoder (VAE). The uniqueness of this model is that it can cleverly handle the inherent nonlinear and high-dimensional characteristics of EEG signals, thereby significantly improving the decoding accuracy and data processing efficiency of the signal. The algorithm in this paper cleverly combines deep neural networks to optimize the signal extraction process and feature selection strategy. The performance of the proposed model is comprehensively evaluated through carefully designed simulation experiments. The experimental results convincingly prove that this model greatly improves the decoding accuracy of brain-computer interface signals while ensuring the processing speed. Specifically, data analysis shows that compared with traditional methods, this model performs well in average classification accuracy, data processing speed and anti-interference ability, achieving significant transcendence. In summary, the deep learning framework proposed in this paper not only demonstrates excellent robustness and scalability, but also opens a new path for the real-time application exploration of brain-computer interface technology, and provides strong theoretical support and practical guidance for the optimization and upgrading of future brain-computer interface systems.

articleTitle: Research on Navigation and Control Technologies for Mobile Robots in Complex Environments Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: To address the issue of poor navigation performance of mobile robots in complex environments, a navigation control method based on deep learning is proposed. This method adopts a hierarchical model framework, which consists of two parts: a low-level part and a high-level part. The low-level part includes obstacle avoidance and target-driven control models, responsible for implementing obstacle avoidance and target approaching behaviors, respectively. The behavior selection model in the high-level part can automatically learn stable and reliable behavior selection strategies, reducing the dependency on manually designed control rules. Furthermore, through optimized training of the obstacle avoidance control model, the learned obstacle avoidance strategies become more adaptable to navigation requirements in complex environments. Experimental results demonstrate that this method can significantly improve navigation performance in complex environments and possess good generalization ability. Additionally, preliminary navigation tests in real environments have also verified the practical application prospects of this method.

articleTitle: Six Degree of Freedom Parallel Platform Control Based on Fuzzy PID and Calculated Torque
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Controlling six-degree-of-freedom parallel platforms, essential in aerospace and medical technology, is challenging due to their nonlinear, multivariable characteristics and parameter coupling. This paper presents a hybrid control strategy that integrates fuzzy PID control with the calculated torque method. The fuzzy PID controller dynamically adjusts parameters to manage system nonlinearity and uncertainty, while the calculated torque method improves control precision by computing necessary actuation torques. Experimental results show that this method reduces branch rod error to approximately 0.2mm with a maximum error reduction to 0.6%, significantly enhancing control accuracy and system stability. This approach offers a promising solution to the complexities of controlling advanced parallel platforms, providing improved precision, stability, and adaptability.

Author Keywords: six degree of freedom parallel platform

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Translation English Corpus Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to further improve the effect of English intelligent translation, this paper combines the idea of deep learning to build an intelligent corpus system. Aiming at the problem of a lot of noise in speech data, the speech data is preprocessed by Mel frequency cepstrum coefficient method, and then transformers are combined with mutual information to recognize speech emotions. Then, by integrating diverse data sources, a wide range of English text data is provided to support complex translation and processing tasks. During the data acquisition phase, English text is collected from online platforms and social media through automated tools. In the data processing stage, advanced text processing technology is used for text analysis and preprocessing to ensure the quality and consistency of data. Finally, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper with experimental analysis. In the future, intelligent English translation subjects should take a positive attitude towards science and technology, and regard intelligent translation technology as an effective tool for English translation.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Constant Temperature Foot Bath Control System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the post-epidemic era, people are more aware of the possibility of novel coronavirus coexisting with human beings, so it is crucial to improve immunity. In the fast pace of life and work state, foot bath has become one of the ways for people to relax. In view of the current market traditional foot bath function is relatively simple, imperfect shortcomings, this paper designed a home intelligent constant temperature foot bath control system. The foot bath with STM32F103C8T6 as the control core, with WiFi communication module, temperature detection module, temperature control module, key control module, vibration module and OLED display module, etc., through the mobile phone APP or key operation can control intelligent constant temperature foot bath control system, can realize automatic constant temperature, remote control, vibration massage, timing reminder, and other functions. The design is practical and innovative, fully meeting the diversified needs of users for foot bath devices.

articleTitle: Optimized Flame Detection Using a YOLOv5 Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the rising prevalence of smart homes, there's an increasing demand for comprehensive automation solutions to mitigate fire risks, especially when homeowners are absent or in homes with elderly residents. This study focuses on enhancing flame detection techniques, particularly for smaller, hard-to-detect fire sources. A customized Yolov5 neural network was developed to improve detection precision. This enhancement was facilitated using a dataset of over 2,000 images from lab camera observations and online platforms. These images were then manually labeled and clustered for anchor dimensions using the K-means++ algorithm. The CIOU and diou _ nms techniques were integrated to optimize the network's performance. Upon training, the refined model was tested on the Jet Nano, revealing its high efficacy in flame detection.

articleTitle: Space-Based Measurement and Control System: Satellite Communication Channel Optimization and Network Security Synergy Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This study addresses the problems of limited satellite communication channel resources and network security threats in space-based measurement and control systems. A synergistic technology scheme for channel optimization and security protection is proposed. A distributed testing and verification platform is constructed to realize the collaborative deployment of dynamic channel allocation and security protection mechanisms. The verification results show that the scheme improves the channel utilization rate by 45.2 % and the security threat detection accuracy by 97.3 % under 200 concurrent measurement and control services. The average response delay is reduced to 82ms. During the three-month actual operation verification, the system availability reaches 99.98%, and 152 security events are successfully handled, demonstrating the practical value of the synergistic technology for satellite communication channel optimization and security.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Deep Learning Algorithms Enabling Robot Target Recognition and Intelligent Localization in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In complex environments, robot target recognition and intelligent localization face challenges such as multi-object, dynamic changes, and occlusion, making it difficult for traditional algorithms to meet the requirements of high accuracy and real-time performance. Based on this, the research improves the YOLOv5 algorithm to construct a target recognition model suitable for complex scenarios and optimizes intelligent localization capabilities by combining technologies such as MobileN etV3 and LSTM. Experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 outperforms mainstream algorithms in various complex environments. In indoor occlusion scenarios, the average precision (AP) reaches 83.4% with an inference speed of 14.3 ms; in dynamic scenes, the AP is 76.7% with an inference speed maintained within 13.8 ms. Comparisons on the Cityscapes dataset indicate that the accuracy of the improved YOLOv5 ranges from 92% to 96%, surpassing Faster R-CNN. Under conditions of high noise and high-speed target movement in dynamic environments, its accuracy is 80.2%, which is approximately 5% higher than traditional algorithms. In summary, the proposed improved method in this research significantly enhances the performance of target recognition and intelligent localization, demonstrating robustness and adaptability in complex environments. It provides effective support for robot intelligent perception technology.

articleTitle: Research on Waxiang Dialect Recognition Based on Wav2vec2.0 Pre-Training and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: As a unique local dialect, Waxiang dialect carries rich regional culture and historical information. However, with the acceleration of modernization and the increase of population mobility, the inheritance and protection of Waxiang dialect are facing severe challenges. By constructing the ‘Xuewatong’ APP- Waxiang dialect digital protection platform, based on cloud storage technology, digital resource display, multimedia integration and other technologies, and providing learning resources through big data analysis of user needs, it can effectively promote the digital recording and preservation of Waxiang dialect language resources, and significantly improve the dissemination and educational effect of Waxiang dialect culture, showing the great potential of digital technology in dialect protection.

articleTitle: Model-Free Adaptive Trajectory Tracking Control for UAVs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This article proposes a model-free adaptive trajectory tracking control approach for UAVs that bypasses the need for precise system modeling, learning control laws directly from system input-output data. By introducing pseudo partial derivatives (PPD) as time-varying parameters, the nonlinear system model is effectively linearized, and a robust PPD estimation algorithm is developed to handle environmental disturbances and sensor errors. Stability analysis and simulation tests confirm the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed control approach.

articleTitle: Design of Endowment Insurance Online Payment Platform Combined with Artificial Intelligence Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of the pension insurance online payment platform and improve the efficiency of pension insurance data processing, this paper proposes an innovative method, that is, the combination of the improved interactive dynamic evaluation method (IDEM-C) and the Adaboost algorithm. Moreover, this paper constructs and develops the online payment platform of old-age insurance, and realizes the real-time monitoring and data statistical analysis of the online payment platform of old-age insurance. The monitoring platform does not affect the normal use of other monitored system platforms, and can provide a unified platform for the monitoring of other systems. The monitoring platform can be integrated with the screen wall, and manage and control the video monitoring function of the screen wall through the portal method. Finally, the validity of the proposed method and model is verified by experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Transportation System in Modern Transportation Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The construction of intelligent transportation system based on the Internet of Things can realize the automation of urban traffic management, and make traffic management more convenient and efficient. Aiming at the challenges faced by traffic management, this paper proposes a set of intelligent transportation system solutions based on Internet of Things technology. The results show that this solution makes full use of the perception recognition and network connection capabilities of the Internet of Things, and is deeply integrated with cutting-edge information technologies such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing. Moreover, it supports the collaborative optimization of complex traffic through multi-source heterogeneous data analysis, thus successfully improving the efficiency of traffic prediction and accident risk assessment. In addition, the simulation results show that the system can effectively improve the efficiency of the road network, reduce congestion delays, and warn accident risks in advance, which is of great significance to promoting future smart travel.

articleTitle: Research on Chronic Disease Auxiliary Diagnosis System Based on Multimodal Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This research examines a system for assisting in the diagnosis of chronic diseases using multi-modal deep learning, with the goal of enhancing the precision and speed of chronic disease diagnosis by combining various types of information like images, text, and clinical data. The research developed a hierarchical system design that consisted of layers for data collection, feature extraction, data fusion, and decision-making. Every level has the responsibility of handling and combining data from various sources in multiple modes. By utilizing feature-level fusion technology, feature details from various modalities are merged to provide a thorough grasp and diagnosis of the illness. Experimental findings reveal that the diagnostic capabilities of the suggested system experience a notable enhancement following the fusion of multi-modal data. In comparison to single-modal approaches, both accuracy and resilience see significant improvement. Case studies confirm the system's efficiency on actual data sets, showcasing its promise in early detection of chronic illnesses and crafting tailored treatment strategies. The findings of this study offer a fresh approach to effectively managing chronic illnesses, with significant practical and promotional implications. This system can more effectively address the requirements of diagnosing complex diseases and offer technical assistance for the smart advancement of the medical field.

articleTitle: Construction of Korean Teaching Resource Library Based on Python Crawler
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The information in the Internet is increasing geometrically, and it is very difficult for users to collect the desired Korean teaching resources information in the network. This paper proposes a data collection method based on Python crawler. The theme of this study is to study the application of deep learning web crawler algorithm based on big data in the information collection and processing of Korean teaching resources. In this paper, the neural network resources are modified, and the propagation activation algorithm is combined to realize the grabbing of web page resources. Combined with the results of experimental analysis, it can be seen that the coverage rate of the algorithm proposed in this paper is much higher than that of traditional algorithms, and the data acquisition and processing speed of the algorithm proposed in this paper is higher than that of existing algorithm models, which means that the algorithm can collect and process data more comprehensively and help to better improve the quality and integrity of information in the process of obtaining information.

articleTitle: Innovative Applications of Human-Computer Interaction Technology in Software Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This article delves into the applications and impact of human-computer interaction (HCI) technology in software development. The research covers cutting-edge technologies such as augmented reality, virtual reality, and multimodal interaction systems, analyzing their contributions to enhancing user experience and efficiency. The article also elaborates on practical strategies such as cross-platform design, accessibility technology, and performance optimization, providing concrete data support. The research results show that these technologies and methods significantly improve the usability and performance of software, pointing the way for future HCI development. This article has important reference value for software developers and researchers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent IoT Platform Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, various intelligent devices generate massive heterogeneous data, posing higher requirements for real-time processing and efficient analysis of the data. Achieving accurate clustering and anomaly detection of dynamic data has become a critical issue in enhancing the intelligence level of IoT platforms. To address this challenge, this study proposes a solution based on an optimized K-means algorithm and deploys it in a smart community environment to improve the system's real-time response and data processing capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm performs excellently in data clustering and anomaly detection. The average clustering accuracy ranges from 93.8% to 94.1%, with a noise point identification rate of 89.2% and a false positive rate controlled at around 4.1%. In tests conducted at different time periods, the running time of the optimized algorithm remained around 120 milliseconds, and the anomaly detection response time was 83 to 86 milliseconds, significantly outperforming DBSCAN, GMM, and hierarchical clustering algorithms. The optimized K-means algorithm exhibits excellent performance in practical applications of IoT platforms, achieving a balance between data processing efficiency and detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Processing Related Data for Automatic Generation of Computerized Reports Using Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This study focuses on the automatic generation of reports in a computerized environment and proposes an algorithm for processing related data based on complex network theory. By using the node and edge relationships in the complex network to construct a data association model, the dynamic association analysis of data in the report generation process is realized. The algorithm is designed based on the potential connection between data and relies on indicators such as degree centrality and clustering coefficient in the complex network to ensure the rationality and consistency of the data in the report. This paper comprehensively simulates the report generation and related data processing process by constructing a multi-level simulation model. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can meet the needs of automatic report generation in terms of accuracy and stability, and still show high robustness when processing data diversity and complexity. The algorithm is significantly superior to traditional methods in terms of association and processing efficiency. This study provides a novel technical idea for the automatic generation of computerized reports, and expands new possibilities for the application of complex network theory in the field of data processing.

articleTitle: Language Model Optimization Based on Quantum Machine Learning for Long Chinese Text Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Chinese language presents unique challenges in text processing due to its complex structure, including high inter-lexical dependence, flexible word order, and rich contextual expressions. These characteristics make it particularly difficult for large models to effectively handle long Chinese texts using traditional machine learning (ML) algorithms. This paper explores the application of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) as a solution to enhance the performance of large language models (LLMs) in processing long Chinese texts. By leveraging the inherent advantages of QML, such as higher processing efficiency and deeper semantic understanding, this research demonstrates through experimental comparisons that QML models significantly outperform traditional ML models in both speed and comprehension accuracy. The paper systematically introduces text processing methods using both traditional ML and QML, and presents a simplified QML model designed to enhance text processing capabilities. The findings underscore the potential of QML in optimizing the future performance of LLMs, particularly for languages with complex linguistic structures like Chinese. This research holds significant implications for advancing LLM technologies in text-heavy applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Tourism Plan Making System Based on Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence will conduct in-depth analysis and mining of massive data in the tourism industry to help tourism enterprises and government departments make more accurate and scientific decisions. In order to further improve the user experience of tourist terminals, this study proposes a personalized tourist route generation modeling method based on user interest model. Moreover, after the theoretical research of this method is completed, its application value is analyzed, and the expected design goal is achieved. Therefore, in the future research, this model can be used to solve the route planning problem, and provide users with more personal tourism routes and tourism schemes. Through the experimental results, it can be seen that the route generation result of this model is good, which proves that this model has high application value. In addition, generative artificial intelligence technology imitates human creative thinking to generate a series of data, images, text or audio content that tourists need, thereby effectively improving the user experience.

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser-Based Intelligent Question Answering System Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The stable operation of power systems is crucial to modern society, where power regulators play a key role in voltage and reactive power regulation. However, the traditional forms of knowledge supply for the operation and maintenance of regulators are in urgent need of innovation. Based on artificial intelligence large model technology, an intelligent Q&A system is constructed to meet the knowledge service needs of power regulator operation and maintenance, thereby enhancing the operational efficiency and stability of the power system. By analyzing the needs of the power regulator field scene, the relevant operation and maintenance knowledge is divided into different topics, forming two major downstream tasks of the model: knowledge object recognition and knowledge Q&A. Combining automatic machine annotation and manual annotation methods, a high-quality small sample training corpus is constructed. By comparing the performance of four existing large language models: BaiChuan2-13B-Chat, ChatGLM2-6B, Llama-2-13B-Chat, and ChatGPT, the model with the best performance is selected as the base model. Following the research idea of “high-quality corpus + pre-trained large model + fine-tuning”, a deep neural network capable of semantic analysis, context association, and generation is trained to adapt to various downstream tasks, building a large model for knowledge Q&A of power regulators. Various strategies such as data optimization and retrieval enhancement generation technology are adopted to alleviate the hallucination problem of large models. The development of an intelligent Q&A system for power regulators generates high-precision, unambiguous operation and maintenance knowledge answers, while also supporting multi-turn Q&A for users.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Database Synchronization Mechanism in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Challenges like network latency, bandwidth limitations, and varied node resources are encountered by distributed databases in edge computing environments. This paper examines a distributed database synchronization mechanism for edge computing to enhance synchronization efficiency and maintain data consistency. It suggests an optimized design involving the weak consistency model and adaptive synchronization frequency adjustment. By building mathematical models and conducting performance tests, the performance of the synchronization mechanism under different network conditions was evaluated, and the advantages of the adaptive synchronization mechanism in key indicators such as synchronization delay, data consistency, and bandwidth utilization were verified. Experimental results show that this mechanism can significantly reduce synchronization delays, improve bandwidth utilization, and maintain low consistency errors under dynamic network conditions, and is especially suitable for edge computing nodes with limited resources. In addition, through practical application cases of intelligent traffic management systems, the effectiveness and application value of the optimization mechanism are further proved. The research in this article provides theoretical support and technical solutions for distributed database synchronization in edge computing scenarios, which helps to improve the data management efficiency and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Degradation Performance Analysis and Reliability Quantitative Evaluation Technology of Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the increase of use time, electronic equipment will inevitably experience performance degradation, which will affect the user experience and system function. In this paper, based on the knowledge of materials science, statistics, data science and system engineering, a quantitative reliability evaluation technology based on degraded data is established. By analyzing the internal mechanism of performance degradation of electronic equipment, this paper develops a Wiener process model based on degradation trajectory to quantitatively evaluate the reliability of electronic equipment. The model assumes that the equipment performance degradation is a random process, and the model parameters are estimated by means of maximum likelihood estimation. In this paper, the reliability of electronic equipment is comprehensively evaluated by using such indicators as mean time between failures (MTTF), failure rate function and residual life expectation (ERL). Taking a sensor widely used in industrial control field as an example, this paper collects its performance degradation data, estimates model parameters, and calculates MTTF and ERL, which provides scientific basis for equipment maintenance, repair and replacement decision. The results show that the MTTF of the sensor is 8.5 years, and the ERL of the sensor that has been used for 4 years is 4.2 years. This study not only promotes the development of the theory and method of reliability evaluation of electronic equipment, but also provides technical support for manufacturers and users, and promotes the sustainable development of electronic products industry.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an Intelligent New Energy Surface Garbage Recycling Vessel Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: To address the issue of water surface garbage pollution, a new energy-powered intelligent water surface garbage recycling boat has been designed. The intelligent water surface garbage recycling boat takes the STM32F103 single-chip microcontroller as the core control unit. And it integrates some modules such as visual recognition, Beidou/GPS dual-mode positioning, and millimeter-wave radar. The unit module design method and the collaborative working mechanism of each module effectively guarantee the realization of the functions of the intelligent water surface garbage recycling boat. Specifically, the motor driving module ensures the normal running and steering of the water surface garbage recycling boat. Besides, the visual module facilitates garbage recycling and intelligent classification on the water surface. Moreover, the Beidou positioning module is utilized not only for daily navigation of intelligent fixed-point garbage recycling, but also for the recovery and utilization of solar and wind energy from all directions. In addition, the millimeter-wave radar on the hull can ensure the safe travelling of the garbage recycling boat comprehensively. The boat designed in this paper exhibits the characteristics of low energy consumption, high performance, and energy conservation and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Monitoring and Risk Assessment System for Ocean Heavy Metal Pollution Driven by Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Aiming at the risk assessment problem of ocean heavy metal pollution, a deep learning-based risk assessment system was constructed. A three-layer evaluation index system including pollutant hazard degree, environmental sensitivity, and exposure risk was established, and a graph neural network risk prediction model was developed. The system achieved a prediction accuracy of 91.2% in the validation of 2,876 monitoring point data. A practical application case showed that the system successfully warned of three potential pollution events in a coastal industrial park, 48 hours in advance, providing important decision-making support for ocean environmental management.

articleTitle: Algorithm Optimization and Implementation of a Multi-Layer Network Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a multi-layer network intrusion detection system (NIDS) using a layered architecture that includes three core functional layers: data collection and preprocessing, feature engineering and detection, and analysis and response. At the algorithm level, an improved incremental SVM algorithm is proposed, along with a hybrid deep learning model based on CNN-LSTM, and an optimized method for determining the density threshold in anomaly detection algorithms. By introducing a dynamic weighting-based multi-algorithm fusion mechanism, the system effectively enhances its detection capabilities against various network attacks. The system is deployed using Docker containerization, integrating core functional modules for distributed data collection, real-time feature extraction, and parallel multi-model detection, achieving high performance and low latency in intrusion detection. Experimental results show that the system meets expected goals in detection accuracy, real-time performance, and scalability, providing effective technical support for security protection in practical network environments.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Grasping Control Technology in Dense Stacking Environments Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: To obtain the optimal grasp sequence and grasp pose for robotic grasping of target objects in dense stacking environments, a stacked object grasping algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. This algorithm consists of two parts: grasp sequence reasoning and grasp pose detection. In grasp sequence reasoning, a segmentation network based on attention and boundary refinement is designed to enhance feature extraction capability and segmentation accuracy. Additionally, a grasp screening method is proposed to select the uppermost unoccluded object as the target to be grasped. In grasp pose detection, a grasp pose detection network integrating multi-scale dense residual modules is designed to preserve multi-scale features of objects while enabling detection of objects of various scales. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves high detection accuracy, enabling the detection of target objects in dense stacking environments while accurately detecting their poses.

articleTitle: Health Insurance Cost Prediction Model Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This research seeks to create a model for predicting health insurance costs using big data analysis techniques, and methodically presents the entire procedure from gathering data, preparing it, engineering features, selecting models, and establishing them. Initially, samples from the US health insurance dataset were utilized for data cleaning and preprocessing to maintain data quality and consistency. Subsequently, through feature selection and dimensionality reduction techniques, key features highly correlated with medical expenses, such as age, gender, type of chronic disease, and historical medical expenses, were extracted. Based on these features, a deep learning model was used to predict health insurance expenses, and the prediction accuracy and stability were improved through model evaluation and optimization strategies. The research results show that the constructed prediction model has high accuracy and good generalization ability in practical applications. Through case analysis of actual data, the application effect of the model in personalized premium pricing, risk management and resource allocation is verified, which can help insurance companies more accurately predict medical expenses and provide decision support. This study provides powerful tools and methods for risk management and cost control in the health insurance industry, which has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on a Model for the Structural Optimization of Freeform Surfaces Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Curved surface shell structures have attracted much attention due to their excellent mechanical properties and broad prospects for engineering applications. However, their optimal design faces challenges such as complex multi-objective nonlinear problem solving and low computational efficiency. This paper proposes an optimization model for freeform surface shell structures based on deep learning. By constructing a complex mapping relationship between geometric parameters, stress distribution, mass and displacement, the efficient optimization of freeform surface shell structures is realized. In this paper, non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS) are used to generate diverse initial geometry samples, and finite element analysis (FEA) is combined to obtain high-quality training data. A fully connected neural network (FCNN) is trained to predict the performance of the optimized structure. The model optimizes both mass and displacement performance through a comprehensive loss function, and its prediction accuracy and optimization effect are verified by simulation and experimental verification. The results show that compared with traditional methods, the deep learning-based optimization model significantly improves computational efficiency and optimization performance. After optimization, the average mass of the shell is reduced by 34.2 %, the maximum displacement is reduced by 28.7%, and the stress distribution is more uniform. The method in this paper provides a new technical path for the efficient optimization and design of complex engineering structures.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Repair Algorithm for Intelligent Processing of Computerized Data in ERP System Using Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This paper studies the adaptive repair algorithm of graph neural network (GNN) in computerized data processing of ERP system to achieve efficient and intelligent data processing. This paper proposes an adaptive repair algorithm based on graph neural network, which models the computerized data in the ERP system as a graph structure, and performs deep feature extraction and anomaly detection on the data through the relationship between nodes and edges. A multi-layer graph convolutional network is used to realize feature aggregation and nonlinear transformation, and the model parameters are optimized through adaptive learning strategy, so that it can dynamically adjust the processing process and enhance the accuracy and flexibility of data repair. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, this paper conducts multiple model simulations on data sets of different sizes. The simulation results show that this method is significantly superior to traditional algorithms in repair accuracy and processing efficiency, especially in high-noise data environments. It still shows strong robustness. Data analysis shows that the repair accuracy of the model in different ERP data scenarios is improved by an average of 18.5%, and the processing speed is accelerated by 22.3%, which proves the potential of combining graph neural network and adaptive repair algorithm in intelligent data processing of ERP system.

articleTitle: Optimization of Federated Learning Algorithm for Non-lID Data: Improvements to the FedDyn Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This paper investigates the optimization of the FedDyn algorithm in Federated Learning (FL). Federated Learning is a distributed machine learning framework that enables model training on local data across multiple devices while ensuring data privacy. However, the existing FedDyn algorithm, while performing well in handling non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data and partial client participation, still faces challenges in large-scale scenarios, such as slow convergence, low training efficiency, and high memory overhead. To address these challenges, this paper systematically optimizes the FedDyn algorithm and proposes several improvements. First, a pre-trained model initialization is introduced, where the global model is pre-trained on a public dataset and then distributed to clients, accelerating early-stage convergence. Second, parallel processing and multi-threading techniques are employed to enhance local training efficiency, and mixed-precision training is used to reduce memory usage and accelerate computation. Additionally, a data volume-weighted hierarchical aggregation method is proposed, ensuring that clients with larger datasets have a greater influence on global model updates, thus improving the model's generalization capability and stability. The effectiveness of the optimized algorithm is validated through experiments on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. Compared to FedAvg, SCAFFOLD, and the original FedDyn, the optimized FedDyn shows significant improvements in test accuracy, convergence speed, and computational efficiency, particularly in handling highly heterogeneous non-IID data. Future work could explore more advanced quantization methods, such as low-bit quantization, to further reduce computational resource consumption, and incorporate techniques like differential privacy to enhance the application in privacy-sensitive domains.

articleTitle: Energy Policy Text Sentiment Analysis Using a Dual-Channel Approach with BERT Embeddings and KAN-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The task of sentiment analysis in energy policy texts presents unique challenges. Most existing methods rely on general word vector models and fail to fully consider the semantic and emotional characteristics specific to the domain. To more accurately capture the sentiment tendencies in energy policy texts, this paper proposes a new model based on the combination of BERT and KAN-BiLSTM with an attention mechanism - BKBA (BERT-KAN-BiLSTM-Attention). The model processes text through two channels: using the BERT model for word embedding, one channel employs KAN to extract text features, enhancing domain knowledge understanding; the other channel uses a BiLSTM network to capture contextual information and global dependencies, ensuring effective handling of long-distance dependencies. The attention mechanism is introduced to focus the model on important features and promote deep interaction between features, better capturing the textual sentiment trends. Experiments show that the BKBA model performs excellently in precision, recall, and F1 score, validating its superiority in the task of sentiment analysis for energy policy texts. Compared with other models, the effectiveness and advantages of the BKBA model are further demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on PCL Remote Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System Integrated with Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Remote monitoring and fault diagnosis of industrial equipment are of great significance for ensuring operational stability and improving production efficiency. However, traditional methods often suffer from insufficient accuracy and real-time performance when dealing with complex and multi-dimensional signals. This study proposes a PCL remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on information technology, targeting various operating conditions in industrial environments. The system collects real-time signals such as vibration, temperature, and pressure from industrial sensors and employs an algorithm framework that integrates Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to achieve efficient fault pattern recognition. The research indicates that the system exhibits excellent classification performance under different operating conditions. Experimental data cover four typical operating conditions: normal state, bearing wear, imbalance, and looseness, with classification accuracies reaching 94.8% (normal), 91.3% (bearing wear), 89.6% (imbalance), and 95.1% (looseness), respectively. Additionally, the model converges rapidly within 30 training rounds, with accuracy stabilizing at 95% and an overall F1 score of 91.3%. In practical applications, the system maintains a prediction confidence of 89.7% to 96.5% for typical faults, demonstrating its stability and applicability under various complex operating conditions. In summary, this study optimizes fault diagnosis methods through integrated algorithms, providing a reliable solution for intelligent monitoring and maintenance of industrial equipment and laying the foundation for further optimization and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on a Game Data Prediction Method Based on an Improved GRU Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the gaming industry, massive amounts of player behaviour data provide a wealth of reference for operational decisions. However, traditional statistical methods are limited in their effectiveness when dealing with complex, high-dimensional, non-linear gaming data. To this end, this paper proposes a game data prediction method based on an improved GRU algorithm. By introducing the Attention mechanism, the model can better capture the long-term dependencies in game data and combined with an adaptive parameter adjustment module to improve training efficiency and model stability. This paper discusses data pre-processing in detail, model architecture design, parameter optimisation, etc., and experimentally demonstrates the significant improvement in prediction accuracy and stability of the improved GRU model. The experimental results show that the improved GRU model not only outperforms the traditional GRU on multiple evaluation metrics, but also exhibits greater robustness and practical applicability.

articleTitle: A Method for Protecting the Privacy of Massive Data Based on Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the context of the demand for large-scale static data release, this paper proposes a security protection method for massive data privacy based on differential privacy. Design an algorithm called Sparkup-Gus (Sparkdi Ferentiar Privasi-Grupinsmuddin), which is protected based on ε differential privacy and is suitable for Spark's memory iteration. The algorithm not only significantly improves the speed of outlier judgment and the efficiency of data difference calculation. It also effectively controls the sensitive influence of outliers in the histogram-based data publishing method on data release. Subsequently, experiments were carried out on the T -Driver trajectory dataset. The results show that compared with other models such as CNN, LSTM and PVTv2, the PVT2-CBAM model proposed in this paper improves the prediction mean absolute error by 45% and 33%, respectively. When the privacy budget is adjusted to 0.3 and 0.7, the average absolute error of the proposed method is increased by about 5% and 28%, respectively, which further verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Robot Target Recognition and Intelligent Localization Based on Improved PSO-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the widespread application of robot technology in target recognition and intelligent localization, issues such as slow convergence and low accuracy in traditional BP neural networks and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithms have gradually become prominent. To address these problems, an improved PSO-BP algorithm is proposed, which optimizes PSO by incorporating chaotic sequences and adaptive strategies. Simultaneously, PSO is utilized to optimize the initial weights and biases of the BP neural network, enhancing recognition accuracy and localization precision. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved PSO-BP algorithm exhibits higher robustness and stability under various lighting and noise conditions. In an environment with 300 lux lighting and low noise, the recognition accuracy of this algorithm reaches 92.5%, with a localization error of 1.12 cm, significantly outperforming traditional algorithms. Furthermore, the algorithm reduces the error to 0.05 within 100 iterations, showcasing rapid convergence. In summary, the improved PSO-BP algorithm demonstrates high accuracy, stability, and efficiency in robot target recognition and localization, providing an effective solution for robot applications in complex environments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of the Bionic Ant Path Planning Algorithm in Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Path planning has emerged as a key problem in the area of robot navigation due to the rapid growth of robotics. In order to address the shortcomings of conventional route planning algorithms in dynamic, unstructured settings, this research investigates a path planning technique based on the Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm. The ACO algorithm simulates the cooperative behaviour and pheromone mechanism of an ant colony foraging, achieving a balance between global optimisation and local search. This paper elaborates on the theoretical basis, path selection rules, pheromone update mechanism and heuristic information design of the bionic ant algorithm, and verifies its effectiveness and superiority in robot navigation through experimental simulation. According to the experimental findings, the bionic ant algorithm has high resilience and practical utility, outperforming conventional algorithms in terms of route length, search efficiency, and adaptability to dynamic situations. The research in this paper provides theoretical support and application reference for solving the problem of robot path planning in complex environments.

articleTitle: Using K-means Clustering Algorithm to Identify Network Attack Patterns in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, network security threats have become increasingly complex and diverse. Traditional network attack detection based on rules or statistical methods can no longer meet the high efficiency and real-time requirements in the big data environment. This paper proposes a network attack pattern recognition method based on K-means clustering algorithm to detect and analyze abnormal behaviors in large-scale network traffic data. Through improvements to the K-means algorithm, including K-means++ initialization, dynamic cluster number determination, and combination with a distributed computing framework, the clustering effect and operating efficiency of the algorithm have been significantly improved. In addition, this paper performs feature extraction and dimensionality reduction on network traffic data, uses t-SNE to visualize the clustering results, and intuitively displays the distribution differences between normal traffic and abnormal traffic. Experimental results show that the improved K-means algorithm is better than the traditional clustering algorithm in terms of accuracy and other indicators, and has good scalability in the big data environment. This article provides an efficient and scalable technical solution for network attack detection, and provides strong support for the intelligent development of network security protection.

articleTitle: Studying the Optimization of a Six-DOF Robotic Arm's Joint Angles Using an Enhanced Particle Swarm Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to increase the precision of the end effector and the effectiveness of route planning, this work suggests a six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm joint angle path optimization technique based on an enhanced particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO). By dynamically varying the inertia weight and acceleration factor, this article improves the method's global search capability and local search accuracy, therefore addressing the issue of premature convergence of the traditional PSO algorithm in high-dimensional situations. In addition, this paper designs an fitness function that targets the Euclidean distance between the end effector and the target position to guide the particle swarm to gradually approach the optimal solution. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm converges faster during the optimisation process, with a minimum error of 2.03324e-09, which verifies its effectiveness and practicality in complex path planning tasks. This method has broad application potential in fields such as industrial automation and medical robotics.

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of a Deep Learning-Based Multi-Class Retinal Vessel Segmentation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, its applications in computer vision and medical image processing have become increasingly widespread, particularly excelling in tasks like image segmentation. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), known for their ability to perform multi-level feature extraction and their adaptable structural design, have become pivotal in the field of medical image analysis. Retinal vessel multi-class segmentation, which is crucial for the early diagnosis of ophthalmic diseases and the extraction of pathological features, has increasingly become a central focus of research. This paper addresses the field of multi-class segmentation of retinal vessels and proposes an optimized deep learning-based model architecture, significantly improving segmentation accuracy and robustness. The model innovatively integrates the feature extraction capabilities of CNN sand incorporates techniques such as the Adam optimizer, dynamic learning rate adjustment, regularization constraints, and early stopping to enhance convergence efficiency and generalization performance. Compared to traditional single-class segmentation methods, this model effectively distinguishes arteries, veins, and their overlapping regions, demonstrating strong adaptability in complex vessel networks and ambiguous areas. Through the application of data augmentation methods, including rotation, flipping, and scaling, the preprocessing process boosts sample diversity, which in turn enhances the model's robustness against varied data. Experimental results reveal that the optimized model delivers outstanding performance across various segmentation tasks and achieves critical breakthroughs in multi-class vessel recognition. While there remains room for improvement in handling intricate details and complex scenarios, the model's multi-class segmentation capabilities and medical application value offer significant insights for future research.

articleTitle: Global Insights on Service Robots: YouTube Data Analysis Across Scenarios: Perspectives from Worldwide Users
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With technological advancements, service robots are gradually replacing human employees in various service scenarios to provide customer service. This study aims to understand consumers' reactions to service robots in different scenarios worldwide by analyzing relevant comments on YouTube. Results based on topic modeling and sentiment analysis show that consumers generally have a more positive attitude towards service robots in airports compared to hotels and restaurants. Meanwhile, there are differences in attitudes towards service robots among consumers from different regions; Asian consumers have a more positive attitude towards service robots in restaurants and airports compared to European and American consumers, while European and American consumers are more positive towards hotel service robots than Asian consumers. Therefore, enterprises should (1) fully consider the impact of service scenarios on consumer attitudes when introducing service robots. For instance, prioritizing the deployment of service robots in utilitarian scenarios such as airports may be more conducive to enhancing customer satisfaction. (2) Pay attention to regional cultural differences and formulate differentiated strategies for Asian and European/American markets. (3) Continuously optimize the experience by collecting and analyzing consumer feedback to continuously improve service robots' functionality and service quality to gain recognition from more consumers.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Decision Making Mechanism for Helicopter Rescue Tasks Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to improve the collaborative decision-making efficiency of helicopter rescue missions in complex dynamic environments, a three-layer collaborative decision-making mechanism based on intelligent computing was constructed. Combining multi-agent system theory, deep reinforcement learning, and improved intelligent optimization algorithms, a multi-objective collaborative decision-making model and real-time strategy generation method were proposed. The study analyzed the resource, time, and spatial constraints of rescue missions, and designed simulation experiments to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the decision-making mechanism. The results indicate that the constructed collaborative decision-making mechanism is significantly superior to traditional methods in terms of task allocation efficiency, path optimization capability, and real-time system response, providing important support for intelligent emergency rescue systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Drug Delivery Robot Based on ARM for Face Comparison
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: After the outbreak of the epidemic, the problem of infection risk has been greatly enlarged. Therefore, in order to treat infectious diseases and reduce the infection risk between people, it is necessary to solve unnecessary contact at the root, so this epidemic promotes the trend of “machine substitution”. An intelligent drug delivery robot based on ARM for face comparison is proposed. The intelligent drug delivery robot with STM 32 embedded system as the core, combining K210 neural network face recognition, upper tact control, voice prompt, intelligent security obstacle avoidance and autonomous tracking is designed. Intelligent robot based on STM32F103ZET6 single-chip computer, equipped with K210 and KPU neural network operator, through HC-06 face recognition, communication with the computer, voice prompt function and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, using MPU605066 axis gyroscope, JGB 37–520 DC deceleration motor and Tb6612 drive motor control the robot posture and operation, in the complex working environment accurately and safely complete the target tasks. Through the experimental test of the system, the operation efficiency and stability of the intelligent robot are verified, which has a certain promotion value in the society.

articleTitle: Design of Precision Planetary Gear Reducer for Industrial Robot Joints Optimized Through the Combination of Genetic Algorithm and Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The demand for high-precision and high-efficiency transmissions in industrial robot joints has made the optimal design of precision planetary gear reducers a key research focus. To address the multi-objective constraints in optimizing transmission efficiency, load capacity, and thermal performance, a hybrid optimization method combining genetic algorithm (GA) and ant colony algorithm (ACA) is proposed. By integrating the global search capability of GA with the local optimization ability of ACA, a two-stage optimization model linking the fitness function to design variables is established. Experimental results demonstrate that this method significantly enhances the performance indicators of the reducer. In multi-condition tests, the transmission efficiency was increased to a maximum of 93.5%, the maximum gear temperature rise was reduced by 4.5°C, and torque fluctuation decreased by 21.7%. The convergence speed of the hybrid algorithm was 16.7%-31.8% faster than that of single algorithms, exhibiting superior computational efficiency. Sensitivity analysis verified the significant impact of modulus, tooth width, and pressure angle on transmission efficiency and stability. Reliability assessment results indicate that the optimized scheme maintains high stability across multiple runs, with result deviations controlled within 0.010. Therefore, the hybrid optimization design based on GA and ACA exhibits significant advantages in improving reducer performance and reliability optimization, providing an effective reference for the engineering design of transmissions in industrial robots.

articleTitle: Research on the Human-Machine Collaborative Optimisation Algorithm for Intelligent Traffic Signal Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: With the worsening of urban traffic congestion, improving traffic flow and resource utilisation efficiency has become an important challenge in the field of intelligent transportation. Traditional traffic signal control systems lack dynamic adaptability and are difficult to cope with complex and ever-changing traffic environments. To address this problem, this paper proposes a bionic ant path planning algorithm based on human-machine collaborative optimisation. The system obtains real-time road traffic data, including information such as signal status, traffic flow and obstacle distribution, through a data acquisition module, and uses an improved ant colony algorithm to achieve global path search and dynamic optimisation. At the same time, a human-machine collaborative interaction mechanism is designed to allow users to adjust path weight parameters in real time according to actual needs, enhancing the flexibility and adaptability of the system. Through simulation experiments, this paper verifies the performance of the proposed algorithm in different scenarios and compares it with traditional path planning algorithms. The results show that the ant colony algorithm based on human-machine collaborative optimisation has significant advantages in terms of convergence speed, path optimisation effect and dynamic environmental adaptability. This study provides an efficient, real-time and flexible path optimisation solution for intelligent traffic signal control systems, which can effectively improve traffic scheduling capabilities in complex dynamic environments.
